## Summary

This PR implements the static-first AAIF Dallas Agentic AI Summit site and its reviewed deployment path.

It includes:

- React + TypeScript + Vite static site backed by validated JSON content
- event schedule, speakers, communities, committees, CORE team, resources, updates, and a separate sponsorship page
- official AAIF branding and type-specific local asset directories
- Luma checkout-button integration
- content validation, UI tests, linting, type checking, and production builds
- private S3 + CloudFront + ACM infrastructure for AWS
- Cloudflare-managed external DNS without a Route 53 dependency
- reviewed PR-based content changes
- GitHub Actions workflows compatible with an organization policy that blocks external actions

## Actions workflow change

The organization rejects these third-party actions:

- `actions/checkout`
- `actions/setup-node`
- `aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials`

All workflows are now action-free and use only runner-provided tooling:

- authenticated `git fetch` for checkout
- Node.js 22 from the runner tool cache
- `npm ci` and the repository's release checks
- `curl` and `jq` to request a GitHub OIDC token
- `aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity` for short-lived credentials
- `aws s3 sync` and `aws cloudfront create-invalidation` for deployment

No workflow declares `uses:`. No long-lived AWS credentials are stored in GitHub.

## AWS OIDC trust

The deployment job uses the protected `production` GitHub environment.

The IAM role trust condition must match the repository's immutable subject exactly:

```text
repo:aaif@244048685/aaif-dallas-community@1468153719:environment:production
```

Required trust claims:

```text
token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud = sts.amazonaws.com
token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub = repo:aaif@244048685/aaif-dallas-community@1468153719:environment:production
```

Required GitHub production environment secret:

- `AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN`

Required GitHub production environment variables:

- `AWS_REGION`
- `SITE_BUCKET_NAME`
- `CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID`
- `SITE_URL`

The IAM role only needs S3 list/read/write/delete access for the site bucket and CloudFront invalidation access for the deployed distribution.

## Infrastructure and DNS

The CloudFormation template creates:

- private, versioned S3 origin
- CloudFront Origin Access Control
- CloudFront distribution
- HTTPS ACM integration
- CloudFront-only S3 bucket policy

The ACM certificate must be issued in `us-east-1` for CloudFront. Cloudflare owns DNS and should point `agenticaisummit.gpairesearch.com` to the stack's `DistributionDomainName` using a CNAME. Do not use Cloudflare Flexible SSL.

## Validation performed

- content schema and cross-reference validation passed
- ESLint passed
- TypeScript checking passed
- 7 tests passed
- production Vite build passed
- all workflow YAML parsed successfully
- confirmed there are no `uses:` entries in `.github/workflows`
- dependency audit reported zero vulnerabilities
- mobile community page has no horizontal overflow

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Confirm the IAM trust policy subject matches the immutable GitHub subject above
- [ ] Confirm the `production` environment secret and variables are configured
- [ ] Confirm the deployment role has only the documented S3 and CloudFront permissions
- [ ] Confirm the CloudFront certificate ARN is issued in `us-east-1`
- [ ] Confirm Cloudflare CNAME and SSL mode are correct
- [ ] Confirm `SITE_URL` points to `https://agenticaisummit.gpairesearch.com`
- [ ] Confirm content, speaker/team assets, sponsor logos, and Luma details are approved

## Deployment scope

The workflow deploys only on `main` or a manual dispatch after protected-environment approval. This PR does not itself create or alter AWS resources; infrastructure is provisioned through `infrastructure/static-site.yml`.
